Tiring day cheers for the shift leads
A month with leash checks in mind
Leash Checks, Calm Hands, Smooth Flights

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, the team kept the pace steady and the tone light, helping travelers move through routine checks without fuss. Clear paperwork, patient coaching, and quick follow-up made the handoffs feel easy, even when a pet needed a little extra reassurance before boarding.

Escalations stayed on the usual calm stepwise review, which kept choices clear for the desk and fair for the traveler. Aurelia Skyways passengers and pets both benefit when the basics are handled well, and that kind of care keeps the whole trip moving smoothly.
